name: Riya Mete
headline: Product Designer | Data-Informed UX, Complex Systems & AI · India, open to relocation
title: Product Designer
subtitle: Data-Informed UX · Complex Systems · AI
summary: Product Designer with 4+ years of experience building end-to-end digital products across gov-tech, fintech, consumer, enterprise, and AI-powered platforms, backed by a Master's in Design from IIT Hyderabad and a Bachelor's in Engineering. Most recently designed the new Aadhaar app with UIDAI at population scale, turning complex policy, technical, and user requirements into simple, trustworthy experiences through research, data, and systems thinking.

items.head: Unique Identification Authority of India (Aadhaar) · UX Designer · Graduation Project · Oct 2025 – Oct 2026
points: Audited the existing Aadhaar ecosystem across systems, policy constraints, support data, and benchmarks; led generative research and field studies with 30+ operators and residents to identify core UX gaps and shape the new app's foundations.

Owned UX across Aadhaar App service journeys, a complex system spanning biometric authentication, security protocols, automated and human-verified flows, and strict regulation, partnering closely with engineering, data, and policy teams.

Designed and shipped Home, profile updates, Services, and biometric lock/unlock journeys, mapping system states, edge cases, errors, and recovery paths so users never hit dead ends; took flows from research and IA through high-fidelity prototypes, specs, engineering handoff, and design QA.
Used funnel analysis & A/B tests to locate onboarding drop-offs and redesigned the flow, lifting onboarding success by 23.8%.

Led post-launch usability testing and turned research and product data into shipped improvements: 83.8% task completion in Services, Play Store rating 2.3 to 4.3, 66M+ downloads, and 13M+ in-app updates in 8 months.
Contributed reusable patterns to the app's design system to keep shared components consistent as services scaled; redesigned Aadhaar's official website for service findability.

items.head: Magnifi.ai (Videoverse) · UI/UX Designer · Dec 2023 – Feb 2025
points: Designed end-to-end experiences for AI-powered B2B media platforms Magnifi.ai and Studio, turning complex AI and automation capabilities into clear workflows for enterprise media teams; led research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to improve feature discoverability and adoption.
Led the marketing website redesign, increasing engagement by 40% and conversion by 21%.

items.head: Lemon Yellow LLP · UI/UX Designer · Sep 2022 – Nov 2023
points: Designed end-to-end experiences for fintech, SaaS, and enterprise cloud clients, including ICICI Prudential Pension Funds, simplifying complex financial journeys, Kubernetes operations, and multi-cloud dashboard workflows.

Facilitated workshops with engineers, product managers, and executive stakeholders to align on problems, explore solutions, and define product direction; UX proofs of concept contributed to a 25% lift in client conversion.

items.head: Menstrupedia · UX Designer · May 2021 – Sep 2022
points: Led the end-to-end redesign of Menstrupedia's website across research, IA, interaction design, prototyping, usability testing & developer handoff; reduced bounce rate from 85%+ to 60%. Work reached 500,000+ girls across 11,000 schools.

Took a gamified learning app for adolescents (Trubuddy) from concept to MVP via Google Design Sprints, building a 200+ screen prototype in a day as the sole designer. Received funding on Shark Tank India S1.

items.head: Master of Design · IIT Hyderabad · 2024 – 2026
points: Master's thesis: Orchestrated Friction Framework – Designing for User Agency in High-Stakes Identity Interactions (published).
